posts.text: Steelers RB Rico Dowdle, who was carted to the locker room on Sunday with a toe injury, checked out relatively OK following tests. He's considered to be day-to-day.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart is getting additional medical opinions on his injured knee that will determine whether to have surgery, which in turn will determine whether he can return this season or not. For now, he’s out indefinitely, as ESPN reported. Jameis Winston takes over as QB1.

posts.author: NFL.com
posts.text: NFL Network: Giants' Jaxson Dart potentially out for season after testing shows worse knee injury - NFL.com

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text:
Giants QB Jaxson Dart suffered a knee injury last night that was worse than anticipated, sources told me and Mike Garafolo after the MRI. 

He’s out an extended period of time, possibly the season.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text:
Bears QB Tyson Bagent is dealing with a concussion and is in the NFL’s concussion protocol, sources say. 

With Caleb Williams likely out with a hamstring injury, Case Keenum could be the starter vs the Eagles.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: The Falcons placed CB A.J. Terrell on injured reserve.

posts.author: Yahoo Sports
posts.text: Saquon Barkley, Puka Nacua, Brock Bowers and more NFL injury updates for Week 3 - Yahoo Sports

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text:
Giants QB Jaxson Dart is believed to have suffered a sprained MCL based on the initial exams, sources tell me and Mike Garafolo. 

X-Rays were negative and the MRI is coming Tuesday. Dart is expected to miss some time, though in general, positive news.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: The Giants have ruled out QB Jaxson Dart for the game because of a knee injury.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text:
Colts star WR Alec Pierce, who aggravated a heel injury that was surgically repaired, will attempt to rehab the ailment rather than have surgery, sources say.

Pierce is slated to be out several weeks while he heals, but if all goes well, he could return midseason.

posts.author: Yahoo Sports
posts.text: NFL Injury Report, Week 3: Latest news, updates for Caleb Williams, more players with fantasy football analysis - Yahoo Sports

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text:
The Falcons are starting Michael Penix Jr for Week 3, as QB1 makes his first start. Penix has deemed his reconstructed ACL ready after splitting reps last week with the 1.

The Packers loom on Thursday.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text:
Saints OT Kelvin Banks Jr suffered a severe high-ankle sprain and is now expected to have surgery to repair it, tests revealed today. He is out indefinitely.

Banks, one of the top young OTs, has a chance to return late in the season if all goes well. But a significant loss.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text:
Saints stellar OT Kelvin Banks Jr., who was carted off on Sunday, is believed to have suffered a high-ankle sprain, sources say.

He’ll have an MRI to determine the severity, but those injuries are often 4-6 weeks and would mean a stint on IR.

posts.author: fantasypros.com
posts.text: Fantasy Football Injury Report & Updates: Week 3 (2026) - fantasypros.com

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: Seahawks RB Jadarian Price, who left today’s game at Arizona with a chest injury, had X-rays that came back negative. More tests Monday, but there’s optimism he avoided any significant injury.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text:
Commanders coach Dan Quinn said QB Jayden Daniels suffered another dislocated left elbow, and he is expected to miss time. X-Rays were negative. 

The last time he had this injury, he missed about a month.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Commanders QB Jayden Daniels dislocated his left elbow again, coach Dan Quinn confirmed, adding that an X-ray didn’t show a fracture.

More tests to come Monday, but Daniels will be out for some time: “We’ll rally around Marcus (Mariota).”

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: The Commanders have officially ruled out QB Jayden Daniels with a left elbow injury.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: Ladd McConkey is officially active.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: Welcome back, TreVeyon Henderson.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: The Packers have ruled out WR Jayden Reed (neck) and RT Zach Bako-Bewele (knee).

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: 49ers RB Kaelon Black (groin) is expected to go on Sunday after being limited some this week, sources say. Coach Kyle Shanahan told reporters this week it was minor.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: Ravens pass-rusher Trey Hendrickson, who broke a finger into several pieces this week, is slated to play on Sunday with cast on his hand, sources say.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: Chiefs star DT Chris Jones, who has dealt with a calf injury, should be good to go for tonight’s game, sources say.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text:
Chargers WR Ladd McConkey, dealing with a cracked rib, practiced Friday and has improved more steadily than anticipated. The team did not elevate a WR and he’s pushing to play, sources say.

There is optimism that he can go today, barring a setback.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: The Falcons are getting healthy, with G Chris Lindstrom (concussion) clearing the protocol and CB AJ Terrell (shoulder) also expected to play, sources say.

posts.text:
Injury news:
— Patriots CB Carlton Davis III has been downgraded to out vs the Steelers.
— Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) won’t practice today and will be questionable for MNF.
— Packers DT Javon Hargrave (knee/concussion) downgraded to out, but edge Lukas Van Ness has cleared concussion protocol.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text: Jets rookie WR Omar Cooper Jr. is going to be placed on Injured Reserve, sources say, giving him four weeks to recover from his ankle sprain. He’ll be designated to return and should be back shortly.

posts.text:
Deshaun Watson and Baker Mayfield meet on Sunday in Tampa for the first time since one of the biggest trades, and wildest weeks, in NFL history.

posts.text:
Jets WR Omar Cooper Jr. is believed to have suffered a high ankle sprain in today’s win over Tennessee, sources say. 

X-rays were negative. Cooper, the first-round pick, will have an MRI on Monday to determine the extent of the injury.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: Myles Garrett is now set to miss games against the Giants, Broncos, Eagles and Bills. L.A. hosts the Cardinals in Week 6.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Rams star Myles Garrett will undergo arthroscopic surgery on his ailing knee and is headed to injured reserve, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports.

Garrett has been dealing with lower-leg pain and wasn’t himself in Thursday’s opener. The hope is he’s back in four weeks.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald says the team got good news on Sam Darnold, who underwent tests that ruled out a hip fracture. Still more tests to come. But Macdonald sounded upbeat about the initial prognosis.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Baker Mayfield’s new contract with the Bucs got him to the $55 million benchmark he wanted. It also prevented a scenario where Tampa Bay would have to carry a nonnegotiable cap number of nearly $80 million for its QB next season.

More in The Sweep: tompelissero.substack.com/p/week-1-not...

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Drake Maye wasn’t the only QB hurting in the Super Bowl. Sam Darnold spent most of the playoffs in a rehab progression for an external oblique strain as the Seahawks made a championship run.

More ahead of tonight’s rematch in a free column at The Sweep: tompelissero.substack.com/p/week-1-not...
